title: Jabez
lead: Jabez is a man of Judah known only from two verses in the middle of a genealogy (1 Chronicles 4:9–10). His name sounds like the Hebrew for "pain," and he prayed to the God of Israel for blessing, wider borders and protection from harm, and God granted his request. Jewish tradition identified him with the judge Othniel; in 2000 a best-selling book made his prayer famous among Christians.
